The '''Cunning Plunderer armor''' was a set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used<ref name="Cartel Market">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref> around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> Variants of this armor included the '''Outlaw Battler armor''', the '''Plunderer's Greed armor''' and the '''Outlaw Warrior armor'''.<ref name="Cartel Market" />
